description: Defines the ProtobufIRReader class for reading and converting protobuf-based IR data structures related to header checking in the Android Open Source Project. Contains method declarations for parsing various protobuf message types into internal IR representations.

classes.name: ProtobufIRReader
classes.description: A class for reading protobuf-encoded IR data and converting it into internal representations for header checking.

methods.name: ReadDumpImpl
methods.description: Implements the logic to read and process a dump file.

methods.name: ReadFunctions
methods.description: Parses function definitions from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadGlobalVariables
methods.description: Parses global variables from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadEnumTypes
methods.description: Parses enum type definitions from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadRecordTypes
methods.description: Parses record (struct/class) types from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadFunctionTypes
methods.description: Parses function type definitions from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadPointerTypes
methods.description: Parses pointer types from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadBuiltinTypes
methods.description: Parses built-in types from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadQualifiedTypes
methods.description: Parses qualified types from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadArrayTypes
methods.description: Parses array types from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadLvalueReferenceTypes
methods.description: Parses lvalue reference types from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadRvalueReferenceTypes
methods.description: Parses rvalue reference types from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadElfFunctions
methods.description: Parses ELF function symbols from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadElfObjects
methods.description: Parses ELF object symbols from a protobuf translation unit.

methods.name: ReadTypeInfo
methods.description: Converts protobuf type info into internal IR type representation.

methods.name: FunctionProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts a protobuf FunctionDecl message into an internal FunctionIR object.

methods.name: FunctionTypeProtobufToIR

methods.description: Converts a protobuf EnumType message into an internal EnumTypeIR object.

methods.name: VTableLayoutProtobufToIR
methods.description: Converts a protobuf VTableLayout message into an internal VTableLayoutIR object.
